prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
For most businesses making paid social ads, **Creatify** is one of the best all-around AI video ad makers. It can turn a product URL into multiple ad concepts, generate UGC-style creator videos, write hooks/scripts, and create variations for TikTok, Meta, and Shorts.

Best choice by use case:

| Need | Best pick | Why |
|---|---|---|
| **Performance/ecommerce ads** | **Creatify** | Fast product-URL-to-ad workflow, UGC-style ads, lots of variations |
| **Realistic AI “creator”/UGC ads** | **Arcads** | Strong focus on avatar-based creator ads and testing different actors/hooks |
| **Polished avatar spokesperson videos** | **HeyGen** | High-quality avatars, voice/lip-sync, localization |
| **Corporate/explainer ads** | **Synthesia** | Professional presenters, brand controls, enterprise workflow |
| **Quick social videos with editing** | **Canva** or **CapCut** | Easiest for teams that also need design, captions, templates, and manual edits |
| **Text-to-video creative concepts** | **Runway** | Better for cinematic or custom visual shots than direct-response ad production |
| **Simple script-to-video ads** | **InVideo AI** | Beginner-friendly and good for stock-footage-based ads |

### My practical recommendation
- Choose **Creatify** if you sell products online and want to produce/test many ad variants quickly.
- Choose **Arcads** if your winning format is TikTok-style UGC ads with believable “creators.”
- Choose **HeyGen** if you need a spokesperson, localization, or a more premium branded feel.
- Use **Canva/CapCut** alongside any of them for final editing, logos, pricing overlays, captions, and platform-specific exports.

The “best” tool is rarely the one with the prettiest AI video—it’s the one that lets you create **20–50 hook/creator/offer variations** fast enough to test.
